term1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
term1.content: By accessing or using the services offered by Data Basis ("We", "Our" or "Us"), you agree to comply with and accept these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with all the terms and conditions of this agreement, you may not use our services.

term2.title: 2. Service Description
term2.content: 2.1. Our services consist of a monthly subscription that grants subscribers access to various exclusive, harmonized, and updated data on the Data Basis platform. Access is provided via Data Basis Python or R packages, or via BigQuery, Google's low-cost and fully managed data storage service for analysis.

term3.title: 3. Payment and Subscriptions
term3.subContent1: 3.1. By subscribing, you agree to pay the specified monthly fee. Payment will be processed automatically each month unless you cancel your subscription before the renewal date, which is clearly stated when you sign up for the service.
term3.subContent2: 3.2. By subscribing, you agree that your data will be used in the creation and maintenance of users on the Stripe payment platform.
term3.subContent3: 3.3. Prices and payment methods are subject to change at the sole discretion of Data Basis. Price or payment method changes will be notified in advance.

term4.title: 4. Cancellation and Refund
term4.subContent1: 4.1. You can cancel your subscription at any time through the options available in your account. However, no refunds or credits will be provided for periods when the subscription was not used.
term4.subContent2: 4.2. You agree to contact us at the email address contato@basedosdados.org before opening a charge dispute with your bank.

term5.title: 5. Responsible Use
term5.content: 5.1. You agree to use our services responsibly and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

term6.title: 6. Intellectual Property
term6.content: 6.1. All intellectual property rights related to the provided data are owned by third parties and are subject to their respective usage policies.

term7.title: 7. Privacy
term7.content: 7.1. The use of your personal data is governed by our Privacy Policy. By using our services, you agree to the collection and use of your information as described in our Privacy Policy.

term8.title: 8. Termination
term8.content: 8.1. We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account at any time, for any reason, without prior notice.

term9.title: 9. Limitation of Liability
term9.content: 9.1. Under no circumstances will we be liable for any direct, indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use or inability to use our services.

term10.title: 10. Changes to Terms of Service
term10.content: 10.1. We reserve the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Changes will be effective upon posting of the updated versions on our website.

term11.title: 11. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
term11.content: 11.1. These Terms of Service will be governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of Brazil. Any dispute related to these terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Rio de Janeiro, RJ, Brazil.

term12.title: 12. Contact
term12.content: 12.1. To contact us with questions or concerns related to these Terms of Service, please send an email to suporte.bdpro@basedosdados.org.

ToS.finalNote: By using our services, you agree to all the terms and conditions set forth in this agreement. Please read these terms carefully before proceeding.

header.subContent1: Data Basis ("We", "Our" or "Us"). We commit to protecting and respecting your privacy and complying with all obligations established in the General Data Protection Regulation ("LGPD").
header.subContent2: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, share and protect your personal information. By accessing or using our services, you agree to the terms and practices described in this Privacy Policy.

term1.title: 1. Information We Collect
term1.subContent1: 1.1. We collect personal information that you provide directly to us when using our services. This may include your name, email address, payment information, and other information you choose to share with us.
term1.subContent2: 1.2. We also collect information automatically, including usage data, IP address, browser type, and information about the device you use to access our services.
term1.subContent3: 1.3. To understand how the site is used and improve it, we record navigation events, such as clicks on buttons and menus, searches (including the search term), table downloads, and plan selection. These events may indicate, for example, whether you are logged in or have a subscription, but they do not include your name, email address, or other data that directly identifies you.

term2.title: 2. Use of Information
term2.subContent1: 2.1. We use your personal information to provide and improve our services, including payment processing, customer support, and user experience customization.
term2.subContent2: 2.2. We will not sell or rent your personal information. We only share it with non-affiliated third parties with your explicit consent or with service providers that help us operate the site, such as Stripe, for payment processing, Google, which processes the messages sent to the chatbot, and the analytics tools described in item 2.3.
term2.subContent3: 2.3. To measure site usage, we use Google Analytics, through Google Tag Manager, and the Meta Pixel. These tools receive the data described in items 1.2 and 1.3 and are subject to the privacy policies of Google and Meta.

term3.title: 3. Cookies and Similar Technologies
term3.subContent1: 3.1. Cookies are pieces of data that help the site remember your preferences and make navigation more efficient.
term3.subContent2: 3.2. We use cookies that are necessary for the site to work, such as login cookies; analytics cookies, which help us understand how the site is used; and testing cookies, which determine which version of a page you see so we can compare improvements.

row1.name: userBD
row1.purpose: When logging into our site, this special cookie is created to store your basic information. This cookie is essential to allow you to remain logged in and access protected areas of the site. Without it, you will not be able to log in.

row2.name: token
row2.purpose: When logging into our site, this special cookie is created to store your access token. This token not only allows you to remain logged in, but also acts as a guardian to ensure the integrity of your settings and personal information.

row3.name: tourBD
row3.purpose: When accessing the search page or a dataset, this cookie is created to track the tour progress on the site. It stores the current navigation status—such as 'exploration', 'started', 'downloads', 'last', or 'skipped'—acting as a reference for the function that manages the guided experience.

row4.name: plan_selected
row4.purpose: Stores the plan chosen on the pricing page so it stays selected after you log in or sign up.

row5.name: service-highlight-ab
row5.purpose: Testing cookie. Determines which version of the services section you see on a dataset page, so we can compare versions.

row6.name: dataset-banner-ab
row6.purpose: Testing cookie. Determines which subscription banner you see on a dataset page, so we can compare versions.

row7.name: _ga, _ga_<id>
row7.purpose: Google Analytics cookies. They distinguish visitors and sessions to produce site usage statistics.

row8.name: _fbp
row8.purpose: Meta Pixel analytics cookie. It measures site visits so we can evaluate the reach of our campaigns.

term3.subContent4: 3.4. By continuing to use our site, you agree to the use of these cookies. If you prefer not to use them, we recommend adjusting your browser settings. Blocking analytics and testing cookies does not prevent you from using the site; blocking necessary cookies will affect your ability to log in and access restricted areas.
term3.subContent6: 3.5. In addition to cookies, the site stores some information in your browser's storage (localStorage and sessionStorage): the email address provided at sign-up, until the account is confirmed; the page you were on, to take you back after logging in; your latest search, so we can measure search usage; and chatbot message drafts. You can delete this data by clearing the site's data in your browser settings.
term3.subContent5: If you have any questions about these cookies or any other privacy issue, please contact us at the email address contato@basedosdados.org.

term4.title: 4. Information Security
term4.subContent1: 4.1. We implement technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access and misuse.

term5.title: 5. Your Rights
term5.subContent1: 5.1. Under the LGPD, you have the right to access, correct, delete or port your personal data. If you wish to exercise these rights or have any questions about how your information is being processed, please contact us at the email address contato@basedosdados.org.

term6.title: 6. Changes to this Privacy Policy
term6.subContent1: 6.1. We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be published on our site, and the last update date will be reviewed. We recommend that you review this Privacy Policy regularly to stay informed about our privacy practices.

term7.title: 7. Contact
term7.subContent1: 7.1. For any questions or concerns related to our Privacy Policy, please contact us at the email address contato@basedosdados.org.

PP.finalNote: This Privacy Policy has been prepared in accordance with the provisions of the LGPD and aims to ensure that your personal information is treated with the necessary respect and care.
